messages:
Carla: Heads-up — eu routing is showing intermittent p95 tokenization stalls on canary. Reproducer is narrow; patch built as v2.3.2-hotfix1 (small change to shard allocator). Can we fast-track an expedited hotpatch in the next ~12m change window? Low blast, canary 5% initially.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: expedited approval requested for release v2.3.2-hotfix1. Please thumbs-up to proceed or reply with block. Suggested command: `/deploy hotfix-eu v2.3.2 --canary --no-wait`. Rollback plan: immediate revert to v2.3.1 if 5xx > 1% or error budget spike. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Ben: +1 from infra. Ran the smoke locally against a copy of canary traffic, KV/cache looks stable. Keep canary at 5% initially, monitor kv hit rate.

Alice M.: I can watch post-deploy. Approving — :thumbsup:. Carla, make the rollback trigger explicit in deploy notes: error budget >5% or 5xxs >1% over 5m.

Carla: Rolling now. Running: `/deploy hotfix-eu v2.3.2 --canary`
`deploybot run id: db3a9`

deploy-bot: Deploybot: started canary rollout -> eu-west1 (5%). Actions: deploy containers, warm kv caches, run health-checks (1m window). Posting metrics to dashboards + hooking alerts. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/1764142424

Ben: Initial health-checks look green (0 errors, latency stable). Watching logs for any shard reassign spikes. :thumbsup:

Alice M.: I'll be on watch for the next 20m. If we see a new 5xx spike revert to v2.3.1 and open an incident. Standby for any rollback request.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary passed 6m health-checks with no regressions. Rolling out to 20% now. No blockers observed.

Carla: Thanks all. I'll draft a short release note and tag product with the fix summary and the rollback criteria. Will follow up once we hit 100% or if we need a rollback.
